//: AIR acquisition colors only; never changes actual drops. Best supported route wins. Adjust per-source probability by location difficulty before applying thresholds. Creature evidence includes the weighted species mix per defeated encounter and full butchery; search evidence includes all rolls, zero-count outcomes and availability gates. //loot: Loot title colors use the greatest baseline find probability across loot sources, with no crafting, trade or danger bonus. Below 0.1% is epic; below 0.01% is legendary. Actual availability gates, not labels, keep selected finds scarce.
